title: Partner status PATCH persistence and client rollback on failure

changes.details: updatePartnerInquiryStatusApi awaits apiRequest directly without swallowing exceptions, allowing calling UI to know mutation outcome.
handleStatusChange captures previous state snapshot and executes optimistic mutation with explicit rollback (setInquiries(previousInquiries)) and error banner on failure.

PATCH /api/v1/rbpc/partner/inquiries/{id} validates state transitions (VALID_INQUIRY_TRANSITIONS), rejects unauthorized cross-tenant mutations with 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE, and blocks reopening closed inquiries.

7 integration tests verifying sequential transitions (new->contacted->confirmed->closed), alternative branches (declined), rejection of disallowed transitions (400), cross-tenant protection (403), unauthenticated rejection (401), and frontend rollback contracts.

verification.rollback_guarantee: VERIFIED - UI never retains unpersisted status on rejection
